name: sedar
description: Fetch Canadian securities filings from SEDAR+ and hand them to Claude: resolve an issuer to its profile, list its filings, and download a filing.

tools.name: sedar_resolve_profile
tools.description: Find a Canadian issuer's SEDAR+ profile number by name or ticker.

tools.name: sedar_list_filings
tools.description: List an issuer's SEDAR+ filings, newest first.

tools.name: sedar_newest
tools.description: The newest filings across all of SEDAR+.

tools.name: sedar_download
tools.description: Download one SEDAR+ filing to a local file.
